messages.subject: Solution for inlabru discussion #149
parts:
Hi all,

This post is to document the solution to the problem i detailed in: https://github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru/discussions/149

Firstly, i converted all units from metres to kilometres to prevent/reduce numerical issues, i would highly recommend doing this. 

Secondly, whilst the data i am using were collected from 64 line transects and i had included each of these in the SpatialLinesDataFrame handed to the "samplers" argument, most of my transects were repeated as many as six times and i was unaware that each of these repeats must be explicitly stated in the samplers argument. That is to say that instead of providing 64 transects to the samplers argument i had to provide 354 transects, which contained an identical SpatialLines object for each repeat of every transect. By accounting for all these sampling instances, the overinflated abundance estimate of approximately 30,000 was reduced down to around 6000.

Hope this helps anyone with a similar issue!

Cheers,
Andrew
